references.text: God declares that Israel shall be His treasured possession and a holy people, the same theme of election and holiness as in Deuteronomy 7:6
Israel is called to be holy because the Lord is holy, and He has set them apart from the nations to be His own
Repetition of the same message that Israel is a holy people for the Lord, chosen as His treasured possession
The Lord confirms that Israel shall be His treasured possession and a holy people, exalted above all other peoples
The Lord has chosen Jacob for Himself and Israel to be His own possession
God has created and formed Israel, calling them by name—they belong to Him
Christ gave Himself to cleanse a people for His own possession, zealous for good works—fulfillment of the promise of a treasured people
Believers are called a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession—a direct application of Deuteronomy 7:6 to the church
